title: Wiktor's Optimization
description: the most popular performance mods,qol and shaders
body:
**Wiktor’s Performance** is a carefully tuned Minecraft modpack built for players who want maximum FPS without sacrificing visual quality or gameplay comfort. It combines powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and C2ME to drastically improve performance, reduce memory usage, and eliminate lag spikes even in heavy worlds.
At the same time, it enhances the look of the game with support for shaders such as Complementary Reimagined and MakeUp Ultra Fast, alongside resource packs like ReShaded, Fresh Animations, and FullSlide for smoother visuals and better immersion. Quality-of-life mods like AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, Chat Heads, and Enchantment Descriptions make everyday gameplay more intuitive and enjoyable.
With additional improvements like Dynamic FPS, Entity Culling, More Culling, and ImmediatelyFast, the pack ensures stable performance during both exploration and intense situations. Wiktor’s Performance is designed to feel lightweight, responsive, and modern—perfect for both low-end and mid-range PCs that still want a clean, enhanced Minecraft experience.
